description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Role Overview

Owner is the leading all-in-one platform for independent restaurants. Guest App Platform is the distribution machine behind thousands of white-labeled restaurant apps: it launches them, signs them, and keeps every one current on the App Store and Google Play at minimal cost.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be the technical lead for that platform as we scale to more and more restaurants. You'll work on problems that look very different from a typical mobile role: Temporal workflows that run across thousands of apps, CI/CD and build infrastructure, code signing and provisioning across Apple and Google accounts at scale, and automation (including AI) that removes manual steps while keeping a human fallback where it matters.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You'll be the technical anchor for the Guest App Platform team, setting strategy, keeping the team focused on its goals, and making the platform self-serve so product teams and Launch Specialists can ship into the app without us.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in-person collaboration.

Why we’re looking for you

The Guest App Platform team is responsible for launching and keeping thousands of white-labeled apps up to date while keeping costs at a minimum. We don't build guest-facing features. We build the distribution machine underneath every app, and the tooling that lets product teams and our Launch Specialists ship into it. If a restaurant joins Owner, our platform is how their app reaches the App Store and stays healthy.

This is not a normal mobile role. Most mobile engineers keep a handful of apps up to date. We manage thousands, day in and day out, across Apple and Google ecosystems, and we automate everything we can, including with AI.

Our Tech Stack

  • Mobile: React Native, Typescript, iOS and Android (universal binaries re-skinned and re-signed per brand)

  • Orchestration: Temporal, scheduled workers, Human-in-the-loop systems

  • Infrastructure & Tooling: CI/CD pipelines, IP proxies, Kubernetes, in-house bulk deployment tooling

  • Backend & Internal Tools: Node.js, TypeScript, Postgresql, Kubernetes, various AWS services.

  • Automation & AI: Browser automation, AI-assisted workflows

The impact you'll have

  • Lead the team technically: set strategy and priorities, make architecture decisions, and keep the team focused on its goals

  • Operate apps at fleet scale: own how thousands of separately branded apps are built, signed, deployed and kept current. Design reliable, observable workflows for launches, releases, store submissions and account operations

  • Own CI/CD and build infrastructure: make builds faster, cheaper and more reliable for other developers.

  • Build the tooling our internal customers need: full-stack tools for Launch Specialists and product teams so they can launch and maintain apps without minimal intervention for us.

  • Delete manual steps: find the work humans do repeatedly and automate it, using AI where it makes sense and keeping humans in the loop where it doesn't

  • Navigate Apple and Google: certificates, provisioning, agreements, App Store review and compliance, at scale

  • Partner across the company: work with product engineering, Launch Specialists and leadership, technical and non-technical alike

  • Build the team: mentor engineers, interview candidates and raise the bar

What we’re looking for

  • Staff-level experience leading a team or area technically: setting strategy, driving alignment, and delivering through others

  • Production experience with Temporal or other similar orchestration tools (required)

  • Strong CI/CD pipeline experience (required): building, operating and optimizing pipelines and build infrastructure

  • Full-stack ability: comfortable building web apps, APIs and database-backed internal tools

  • Experience with mobile release engineering: signing, provisioning, store submission, and release management. Experience doing this across many apps, accounts or brands is a strong plus

  • Strong communicator who works well with both technical and non-technical coworkers

  • A bias for automation: you'd rather delete a manual step than add a feature

  • Experience at a product-focused startup, scale-up or technology company

  • Ownership, and comfort with ambiguity and cross-cutting problems

  • Past work experience in hospitality, retail, or IT is a plus

Compensation and benefits

  • The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre-IPO equity package

  • Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote-first workplace), unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.
